messages:
marco: quick heads-up  onboarding NebulaX-7B (hf checkpoint) on AWQ-int4 broke the scheduled-assistant smoke tests. date/time shifts + emoji-triggered token merges. fp16 baseline almost perfect, int4 has huge date-shift rate.

hana: ugh. what numbers?

marco: short numbers from smoke (100 examples):
- fp16 baseline: date-shift rate 2%, slot-accuracy 94%, ppl 10.5, p50 180ms
- awq-int4 (default convert): date-shift rate 43%, slot-accuracy 62%, ppl 26.3, p50 48ms

ryan: that's massive. do we see token id diffs for emoji / zwj sequences? those are sticky for tokenizers.

mila: ran a token-id diff on 10 failing examples  here's one: input "Schedule meeting 🕒🇫🇷\u200d📅 next Tuesday"
- fp16 tokens: [Schedule, meeting, 10234, 4021, 20072, 512]
- int4 tokens: [Schedule, meeting, 99999, 4021, 20072, 512]
So the clock emoji folded to a fallback id in the int4 artifact.

tokenizer-bot: artifact metadata check: model card tokenizer.normalizer = "emoji_safe_v2", converter wrote metadata.tokenizer_normalizer = "emoji_safe_v1" during packaging.

ryan: that explains the emoji fallback. but date-shift weirdness suggests more: are embeddings for timezone tokens drifting or projection rows permuted? any embed diffs?

mila: embed-proj diff for token id 20072 (country-flag subtoken) shows sign inversion in first 16 dims after pack. sample fp16[0:8] ~ [0.012, -0.003, 0.001, ...] vs int4 ~ [-0.210, 0.115, ...]. Looks like an endian/packing order issue in the embed_proj block.

marco: converter logs show we defaulted embed-proj-order=colmajor for this family, but the checkpoint expects rowmajor (family note: NebulaX uses rowmajor).

quant-bot: also ran per-head attention energy histogram for long examples: several heads in mid layers show phase inversion / near-zero energy after ~40 tokens when emoji/zwj runs appear. last-layer head energies (float vs int4):
float16: [0.11,0.12,0.10,0.13,0.12,0.11,0.10,0.12]
int4:    [0.10,0.00,0.00,0.11,0.00,0.09,0.00,0.10]
several heads zeroed.

hana: zeroed heads + embed sign flips + tokenizer normalizer mismatch = compounded failures. any evidence of qkv_layout mismatch?

mila: checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout = "hnp". converter canonicalized to "nhp" silently. that would make per-channel scales computed across wrong axis and can zero heads in AWQ.

ryan: action plan suggestions:
1) patch converter not to change tokenizer.normalizer (preserve existing unless user overrides).
2) add an embed-proj-order parity check: compute checksum on unpacked blocks, fail convert if mismatch, or auto-flip with warning.
3) require explicit qkv-layout flag when checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout present and different from expected. add per-head scale histogram gate (fail if >2 heads scale < 1e-6).
4) add token-id parity smoke for emoji/ZWJ-heavy set (500 tokens) and a small schedule-smoke (10 examples) to onboarding for assistants.

ci-bot: queued job 93021 (node=gpu-e2) to repro with corrected flags.

marco: quick repro commands i ran:
```
rwd-convert --src nebulax-7b/fp16.ckpt --dst nebulax-awq.int4 \ 
  --method awq --block-size 128 --calib-samples 1024 --headwise-quant true

rwd-infer --model nebulax-awq.int4 --task schedule --prompt-file tests/schedule/emoji_mixed.txt \
  --tokenizer emoji_safe_v2 --rotary_scale 1.0 --max-tokens 256 --dump-toks --dump-attn
```

mila: ran corrected runs A/B: A) keep original artifact but override tokenizer to emoji_safe_v2, B) re-convert with embed-proj-order=rowmajor + qkv-layout=hnp + scale-clamp=1e-5 and preserve tokenizer metadata. results (100 ex):
- int4 (tokenizer override only): date-shift 27%, slot-acc 78%, ppl 18.4, p50 49ms
- int4 (re-convert fixes + clamp + preserve metadata): date-shift 4%, slot-acc 91%, ppl 11.8, p50 51ms
- fp16 baseline: date-shift 2%, slot-acc 94%, ppl 10.5, p50 180ms

hana: good recovery. tokenizer override recovered some things but embed/qkv fixes needed to fully restore behavior.

ryan: nice. follow-ups: PR to converter with three small gates + embed-order auto-check (PR #8342), add emoji/ZWJ token-id smoke to CI, add schedule assistant micro-smoke to onboarding (5 examples). Also capture per-head prequant norms in artifact so calibs can auto-decide head exclusion.

quant-bot: job 93021 completed  artifacts uploaded: nebulax-awq-v2.quant (embed/qkv fixed, metadata preserved).

marco: opening the onboarding ticket and PRs, tagging @mila @ryan for review. adding note to model card: "recommended convert flags for AWQ: --qkv-layout hnp --embed-proj-order rowmajor; if you see emoji/ZWJ drift, check tokenizer.normalizer parity." :white_check_mark:
